response.headline: Rising RR and temperature with new breathlessness and shivering; review needed now

summary_points.text: 13:00 obs: HR 90, SpO2 96, RR 19, SBP 127, Temp 37.9, alert, on air.
RR and temperature have risen steadily since 08:00, flagged as deviations at 13:00.
Patient message at 12:00 reports more breathlessness walking to the bathroom than yesterday, and feeling shivery.
Rule-based NEWS2 reads 0 at 13:00 despite the RR and temperature deviations.
Nurse note 07:00 today: slept poorly due to cough, otherwise feels okay, vitals within plan.
Queue flagged for TREND and SYMPTOM_MESSAGE, first flagged 12:00.

plan_rules.rule: Custom escalation: NEWS2 of 5 or more, any single parameter score 3, SpO2 below 93 on air sustained over 1 h, or new oxygen requirement
NEWS2 urgent threshold 5 or single parameter 3

relevant_history.text: Admitted 2026-11-18 with right lower lobe pneumonia; CRP 186 on admission.
Progress note 2026-11-19: afebrile over 24 h, CRP 112, transferred home with IV cefotaxime via pump.
Previous pneumonia Feb 2025 required 2 L/min oxygen for 3 days; low readmission threshold set.
Lives with husband at home; independent in ADL; no treatment limitations.

suggested_actions.action: Consider same-day physician review of the symptom message and rising RR and temperature trend.
suggested_actions.rationale: Patient reports worsening exertional breathlessness and shivering while RR and temperature are flagged.

suggested_actions.action: Consider contacting patient now to check breathing, shivering and pump status.
suggested_actions.rationale: Symptom message at 12:00 has no documented clinician response in the record.

suggested_actions.action: Consider measuring SpO2 on exertion and repeating full observations before the next scheduled review.
suggested_actions.rationale: Resting SpO2 is 96 but the patient reports breathlessness on walking.

suggested_actions.action: Consider the planned day 5 bloods and whether earlier bloods are needed.
